articles.title: This Will Also Pass — Including the Good Parts
articles.titleHinglish: Yeh Bhi Guzar Jaayega — Achha Waqt Bhi
articles.content:
The phrase is usually offered as comfort during a bad time, and it works. But it is only half of the teaching, and the half that gets left out is the one that changes how you live.

The full version applies to everything. The difficult month will pass. So will this Sunday, with everyone in the house, healthy, arguing about nothing. So will your parents being able to walk without help. So will the version of your child who currently wants your attention.

Most people only apply impermanence to suffering, which turns it into a coping tool. Applied to good things, it becomes something more useful — a reason to be present now rather than at some future point when things have finally settled.

There is a way to practise it that is not morbid. Once in a while, in an ordinary moment, note quietly that this arrangement is temporary. Not with dread — with attention. The evening meal with your family in exactly this configuration will not exist in ten years. Nothing needs to be said out loud. What changes is the quality of the attention you bring to a thing you would otherwise treat as permanent background.

The same practice makes the difficult things lighter. When you are inside a bad stretch, the mind insists it is a permanent state — this is my life now. It is not. Almost nothing is. The stretch you are in has an end, even if you cannot see where it is from inside, and remembering that is often enough to get through another week.

There is one more use, and it is the sharpest. Impermanence is a decision-making tool. Given that this will end, is this how I want to spend the middle of it? People stay in the wrong job, the wrong argument, and the wrong silence for years, on the assumption that there will be time to fix it later. Sometimes there is. Often the situation ends first, and what remains is the way it was spent.

And on the hardest version of this — losing people. Impermanence does not soften grief, and anyone claiming otherwise has not lost much. What it does is make you call your mother today rather than on Sunday. That is the entire practical content of the teaching, and it is worth more than any comfort it might provide later.
articles.contentHinglish:
Yeh line aksar bure waqt mein tasalli ke liye di jaati hai, aur wo kaam karti hai. Par yeh shiksha ka aadha hissa hai, aur jo hissa chhod diya jaata hai wahi aapke jeene ka tareeka badalta hai.

Poora version har cheez par lagta hai. Mushkil mahina guzar jaayega. Yeh Sunday bhi guzar jaayega — ghar mein sab, swasth, bekaar ki baat par bahas karte hue. Maa-baap ka bina sahaare chalna bhi. Aapke bachche ka wo version bhi jise abhi aapka dhyan chahiye.

Zyadatar log anitya ko sirf dukh par lagate hain, jisse wo bas jhelne ka auzaar ban jaata hai. Achhi cheezon par lagao to wo kuch zyada kaam ka ban jaata hai — abhi maujood hone ki wajah, na ki kisi aage ke waqt mein jab sab kuch aakhirkaar set ho jaayega.

Ise practise karne ka ek tareeka hai jo udaas nahi hai. Kabhi kabhi, kisi aam lamhe mein, chupchaap note kar lo ki yeh sthiti asthayi hai. Dar ke saath nahi — dhyan ke saath. Parivaar ke saath shaam ka khaana theek isi banawat mein das saal baad nahi hoga. Bolne ki zaroorat nahi hai. Jo badalta hai wo us cheez par diya gaya dhyan hai jise aap warna permanent background samajh kar chhod dete.

Wahi practice mushkil cheezein halki karti hai. Jab aap bure daur ke andar ho, dimaag zid karta hai ki yeh permanent halat hai — ab meri zindagi yahi hai. Nahi hai. Lagbhag kuch bhi nahi hai. Jis daur mein aap ho uska ant hai, chahe andar se wo dikh nahi raha ho — aur yeh yaad rehna aksar ek aur hafta nikalne ke liye kaafi hota hai.

Ek aur istemaal hai, aur wo sabse tez hai. Anitya faisla lene ka auzaar hai. Jab yeh khatam hona hi hai, to iska beech ka hissa main aise hi bitaana chahta hoon? Log galat job, galat bahas aur galat khamoshi mein saalon rehte hain, is umeed mein ki theek karne ka waqt baad mein hoga. Kabhi hota hai. Aksar sthiti pehle khatam ho jaati hai, aur jo bachta hai wo yeh hai ki wo waqt kaise bitaya gaya.

Aur iske sabse mushkil version par — logon ko khona. Anitya gham ko narm nahi karta, aur jo ulta kehta hai usne zyada khoya nahi hai. Wo jo karta hai wo yeh hai ki aap maa ko Sunday ki jagah aaj call karte ho. Is shiksha ka poora practical hissa yahi hai, aur wo baad mein milne wali kisi bhi tasalli se zyada keemti hai.

articles.title: Time Is the Only Thing You Cannot Earn Back
articles.titleHinglish: Waqt Hi Ek Cheez Hai Jo Wapas Nahi Kamayi Ja Sakti
articles.content:
People guard money carefully and give away time to almost anyone who asks. This is strange, given that money can be regained and time cannot.

Some arithmetic, which is unpleasant and useful. If you live in a different city from your parents and see them twice a year for a week, and they are sixty, then in the ordinary case you have perhaps twenty to thirty more meetings with them. Not years — meetings. The number is small enough to count, and most people have never counted it.

The same applies elsewhere. The friend you have been meaning to call for eight months. The child who is currently seven and will be seven for one more year. The health you are spending now to earn money you intend to spend on health later.

This is not an argument for guilt, and it is certainly not an argument that you should quit your job and move home. Most people cannot, and the obligations are real. It is an argument for accuracy — for knowing what a decision actually costs, rather than assuming the supply is unlimited.

A few practical consequences.

Spend on time when you can afford it. A more expensive flight that gets you home the same evening, help with a chore that returns two hours, a slightly higher rent near your office instead of two hours daily in traffic. People will spend on objects for years and never once buy back an hour.

Protect the recurring slots rather than planning grand occasions. A ten-minute call every Sunday accumulates into far more than an elaborate trip once a year that keeps being postponed.

Be careful about what you defer. Ambition is usually financed by borrowing from time — you will rest later, you will see people later, you will be present later. Some of that borrowing is reasonable. It becomes dangerous when the repayment date is always another two years away.

And notice where the hours are actually going. Most people believe they have no time and also cannot account for three hours of the evening. The purpose of tracking is not discipline; it is finding out whether your life matches your stated priorities. Usually it partly does not, and that gap is the most useful thing you can learn in a week.

One fair note. Not every hour has to be productive or meaningful. Rest is not waste, and an evening spent doing nothing with someone you love is one of the better uses of a life. The point is not to optimise your time. It is to stop spending it by accident.
articles.contentHinglish:
Log paisa sambhaal kar rakhte hain aur waqt lagbhag har maangne wale ko de dete hain. Yeh ajeeb hai, kyunki paisa dobara kamaya ja sakta hai aur waqt nahi.

Thoda hisaab, jo bhaddha bhi hai aur kaam ka bhi. Agar aap maa-baap se alag sheher mein rehte ho aur saal mein do baar, hafte bhar ke liye milte ho, aur wo saath saal ke hain — to aam haalat mein aapki unse shayad bees se tees mulaqatein aur bachi hain. Saal nahi — mulaqatein. Ginti itni chhoti hai ki gini ja sakti hai, aur zyadatar logon ne kabhi gini nahi.

Yahi baaki jagah bhi lagti hai. Wo dost jise aath mahine se call karne ka soch rahe ho. Wo bachcha jo abhi saat saal ka hai aur ek saal aur saat ka rahega. Wo sehat jo aap abhi kharch kar rahe ho taaki wo paisa kamaya ja sake jise aap baad mein sehat par kharch karna chahte ho.

Yeh guilt ki dalil nahi hai, aur bilkul yeh dalil nahi hai ki job chhod kar ghar aa jao. Zyadatar log nahi kar sakte, aur zimmedariyan asli hain. Yeh sahi hisaab ki dalil hai — yeh jaanne ki ki ek faisle ki keemat sach mein kya hai, bajaye yeh maan lene ke ki supply asseem hai.

Kuch practical nateeje.

Jab afford kar sako, waqt par kharch karo. Thodi mehngi flight jo usi shaam ghar pahuncha de, kisi kaam mein madad jo do ghante wapas de, office ke paas thoda zyada kiraya bajaye rozana do ghante traffic ke. Log saalon cheezein khareedte hain aur ek baar bhi ek ghanta wapas nahi khareedte.

Bade mauke plan karne se behtar hai dohraane wale slot bachao. Har Sunday ka dus minute ka call us shandaar saalana trip se kahin zyada jama karta hai jo baar baar aage badhti rehti hai.

Dhyan rakho ki aap kya taal rahe ho. Mahatvakanksha aksar waqt se udhaar leke chalti hai — aaram baad mein, logon se milna baad mein, maujood hona baad mein. Us udhaar ka kuch hissa waajib hai. Wo khatarnaak tab ho jaata hai jab chukane ki taareekh hamesha do saal aage hi rehti hai.

Aur dekho ki ghante ja kahan rahe hain. Zyadatar log maante hain ki unke paas waqt nahi hai aur shaam ke teen ghante ka hisaab bhi nahi de paate. Track karne ka maqsad anushasan nahi hai; maqsad yeh pata lagana hai ki aapki zindagi aapki batayi hui priorities se milti hai ya nahi. Aksar poori nahi milti, aur wahi gap ek hafte mein seekhne laayak sabse kaam ki cheez hai.

Ek imaandaar baat. Har ghante ka productive ya gehra hona zaroori nahi. Aaram barbaadi nahi hai, aur apne kisi pyaare ke saath kuch na karte hue bitaayi shaam zindagi ke behtar istemaal mein se ek hai. Baat waqt ko optimise karne ki nahi hai. Baat use galti se kharch hone se rokne ki hai.
